title: Universal Life Insurance Service Desk Rules: Face Decreases and Death Benefit Option Changes
content:
## Rules

The owner of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy may decrease the face amount or change the death benefit option by signed request, effective on the next monthly anniversary.

- A face or option change is processed only while the policy status is in force, as the policy record shows.
- A face or option change is made only on a change request signed by the owner and approved, as the policy's service record shows.
- A requested face decrease takes effect only from the tier's first face decrease policy year, and may not reduce the face below the tier's smallest face amount.
- During the surrender charge period a face decrease incurs a surrender charge of the decrease divided by 1000 times the tier's surrender charge schedule rate for the current policy year, rounded to the cent.
- A change from Option B to Option A is allowed where the tier allows it, and sets the face amount to the face amount plus the account value.
- A change from Option A to Option B is allowed only where the tier allows it, and otherwise is not available through policy service.
- A face increase requires new underwriting and is not available through policy service.

## Points of judgement

| Request | Outcome under these rules |
|---|---|
| Face decrease in policy year 1 | Does not take effect; decreases take effect only from the first face decrease policy year |
| Face decrease that would leave the face below the tier's smallest face | Not made |
| Option B to Option A on a tier that allows it | Made; new face is the face plus the account value |
| Option A to Option B on a tier that does not allow it | Not available through policy service |
| Face increase | Not available through policy service; requires new underwriting |
| Any change while the policy is in the grace period | Not processed; the status is not in force |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- **Decrease charge.** An Ashgrove Protection UL in policy year 3 (schedule rate 22.00 per $1000) decreases its face by $100000.00: 100 times 22.00 is a surrender charge of $2200.00. The same decrease in policy year 11, after the tier's 10 surrender charge years, incurs no surrender charge.
- **Option change.** An Option B policy with a face of $300000.00 and an account value of $45000.00 changing to Option A takes a face of $345000.00, effective on the next monthly anniversary.
